sl.lead: Write down all your debts, including those to family and friends. The list shows what matters first. It also helps you at the debt counselling service.

sl.prio.lead: This is what debt counselling services recommend: first food, rent and electricity. Criminal fines also have priority. Instalments to banks, debt collectors or mail-order companies come last. The app also puts maintenance and health insurance at the top, because otherwise there is a risk of punishment or of losing health insurance benefits.
sl.stufe.1: First: protects your home, electricity, health and freedom
sl.stufe.3: Can usually wait until you have had advice
sl.frist.mahnbescheid: Payment order delivered on {d}. If the claim is wrong or only partly right, object if possible by {frist}. After that, an enforcement order can come at any time.
sl.frist.vollstreckungsbescheid: Enforcement order delivered on {d}. An appeal (Einspruch) is only possible until {frist} (strict deadline). Warning: with the enforcement order, seizure is already allowed now, even if you appeal. Get help immediately.
sl.frist.mahnbescheid.vorbei: The 2 weeks since delivery on {d} have passed. An objection is still possible as long as the court has not yet issued an enforcement order. Act today.
sl.frist.vollstreckungsbescheid.vorbei: According to the app's calculation, the appeal deadline since delivery on {d} has passed. Go immediately with the order and the envelope to a debt counselling or legal advice service. They will check what is still possible.
sl.frist.ungefaehr: Rough calculation: 2 weeks from delivery. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day. The app only knows the nationwide public holidays, not those of your federal state. It may therefore show a day that is too early. What counts is the delivery date the postal worker noted on the envelope.
sl.frist.ohneDatum: Add the date from the yellow envelope, and the app will roughly calculate the deadline.
sl.dringend: Urgent: get help from a debt counselling service today and tell them that your home, electricity, account or freedom is at risk.
sl.warum.miete: If you have rent arrears, the landlord can terminate without notice: if on 2 consecutive dates you owe more than one month's rent, or over a longer period 2 months' rent. If you pay everything back at the latest 2 months after the eviction claim is served, or the authority commits to paying, the termination without notice becomes invalid, but only once in 2 years. If the landlord has also given ordinary notice, that termination can remain despite payment. The Jobcenter or social welfare office (Sozialamt) can take over rent arrears, usually as a loan.
sl.warum.energie: The supplier may only cut off electricity or gas if, after a reminder, you are at least 2 monthly instalments and at least 100 € in arrears. The cut-off must be threatened 4 weeks in advance and announced 8 working days in advance. The cut-off is not allowed if it would hit you disproportionately hard (for example a risk to health); write this to the supplier. With the basic supplier (Grundversorgung) you can demand an agreement with interest-free instalments after the threat. If you receive basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld) or social assistance and a cut-off is threatened, you can apply for a loan at the Jobcenter or social welfare office (Sozialamt). The authority decides case by case whether you get it.
sl.warum.unterhalt: Maintenance secures the living costs of your children or other entitled persons. Anyone who evades the maintenance obligation can commit a criminal offence. For maintenance, more of your wages may also be seized than usual.
sl.warum.geldstrafe: If a criminal fine cannot be collected, a substitute prison sentence is possible: 1 day of detention for 2 daily rates. Ask the public prosecutor's office early about paying in instalments. In many federal states you can avoid detention by doing community work.
sl.warum.kranken: Statutory health insurance: if you are 2 months behind with contributions and do not pay despite a reminder, your right to benefits is suspended. Only the treatment of acute illnesses and pain, benefits during pregnancy and maternity, and early-detection check-ups remain. If you are in need of assistance (Grundsicherungsgeld, social assistance), nothing is suspended. With an instalment agreement you get all benefits again, as long as you pay the instalments on time. Private health insurance: after 2 reminders the contract is suspended and you are insured in the emergency tariff.
sl.warum.bussgeld: If you do not pay an administrative fine and do not show that you cannot pay it, the court can order coercive detention. Tell the authority early that you cannot pay, and ask about instalments.
sl.warum.behoerde: The Jobcenter can offset repayment claims against your ongoing basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld) (10 or 30 percent of the standard rate). Together it may be at most 30 percent. Check the decision. You can object to a wrong Jobcenter decision within 1 month of receiving it. For other authorities, the deadline is at the end of the decision.
sl.warum.rest: Banks, debt collectors, mail-order companies and mobile phone companies cannot take away your home, electricity or freedom. But they can have things seized if a court has confirmed the claim (for example by an enforcement order). Then the seizure exemption limit and the P-account (P-Konto) protect you. According to debt counsellors, these instalments come last. Do not sign anything and do not agree to new instalments before you have had advice. But keep paying your current phone and internet costs.
sl.hilfe.1: Search by postcode: meine-schulden.de → „Hilfe finden“ (Federal Association for Debt Counselling, BAG-SB). There you can choose a radius and filter by „kostenfrei“ (free of charge), P-account certificates or insolvency counselling.
sl.hilfe.2: Do you receive basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld, formerly Bürgergeld)? The Jobcenter can arrange or pay for debt counselling if it helps you find or keep work (no fixed entitlement). Ask your contact person.
sl.hilfe.3: Do you receive social assistance or basic income support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter)? If debt counselling is necessary, the social welfare office (Sozialamt) must point you to it and support you. It should cover reasonable costs if the emergency cannot otherwise be overcome. In other cases it can cover them.
sl.hilfe.4: Recognised services are run by welfare associations (for example Caritas, Diakonie, AWO), consumer advice centres and towns or districts. They are usually free of charge. Be careful with companies that want money in advance or a new loan.
sl.hilfe.5: Is it urgent (eviction, electricity or gas cut-off, detention, account blocked)? Say so on the first call. Then the service can help even before the actual counselling.
sl.druck: Sheet for the debt counselling service
sl.druck.intro: An overview to take with you. Your name is not on it. But reference and customer numbers are, and they can identify you. Still bring the letters with you.
sl.druck.nurDeutsch: The sheet is in German so that the counselling service can read it.
sl.druck.titel: List of creditors – overview for the debt counselling service
sl.druck.hh: Budget plan: income {e}, fixed expenses {a}, remainder {r}; free before instalments: {f}
sl.druck.hinweis: Own details, not checked. General information, not legal advice. Rules as of: November 2026.
sl.druck.privat: The sheet contains details about your debts. Only give it to the counselling service and do not leave it lying around.
sl.u.1: Proof of your income: pay slip, decisions about pension, unemployment benefit, basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld), social assistance, housing benefit (Wohngeld), child benefit (Kindergeld)
sl.u.2: An overview of monthly income and expenses (budget plan)
sl.u.3: All letters about the debts, sorted by creditor, newest on top, with dividers, without plastic sleeves
sl.u.4: Contracts, bills, reminders, letters from debt collectors and lawyers, statements of claim
sl.u.5: Court mail: payment and enforcement orders, judgments, seizure orders, summons to disclose assets
sl.u.6: Notices to quit, cut-off threats, maintenance titles, administrative fine notices, decisions on criminal fines
sl.u.7: Acknowledgements of debt and instalment agreements that you have signed
sl.u.8: Don't know who you owe what? You can request a free copy of your data from credit agencies (for example Schufa) (not the paid credit report).
sl.csv.warn: The file contains details about your debts. Only save or share it where others cannot see it. Delete it afterwards.
